company.shortDescription: Atom Learning is a fully adaptive, online teaching platform for Key Stage 2, early Key Stage 3 and senior school entry preparation.
company.description: We believe students of all backgrounds and attainment levels should experience the benefits of personalised education. We combine the highest quality teacher-produced content with adaptive technology for a personalised and impactful learning experience. Our solutions are used both at home and in schools, as we lead the way in modernising education globally.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $25,126,127, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $138,734,177 to $138,734,177, a 1x increase.
